item.title: The Prestige dedicates annual award to the late Johnny Brande
item.description: Brande, a 16-year-old golfer, died last year after battling Ewing Sarcoma, attended The Prestige at PGA West every year, and participated in the junior clinic where college coaches met with and gave instruction to young golfers. The golf community at PGA West gathered on Sunday to honor Johnny Brande and hand out an award in his name. The first of many that will carry his legacy forever. For more Coachella Valley News visit NBCPalmSprings.com

item.title: President’s Day Storm Brings Rain to Coachella Valley as Fair Continues
item.description: It’s a wet President’s Day across Southern California as the first of three winter storm systems moves into the region.Forecasters say at least half an inch of rain is expected through Tuesday, with another round possible Wednesday. item.title: Big Bear Coffee Shop Hosting Olympic Watch Parties for Final Week of Games
item.description: With the Winter Olympics entering their final stretch, one of Big Bear’s most popular gathering spots is inviting fans to catch the action in style.Moonridge Coffee Company, located along the corridor in Big Bear, has become an unofficial hub for Winter Games viewing. item.description: This morning the reality of another partial federal government shutdown is settling in after the U.S. Department of Homeland Security ran out of funding over the weekend with no agreement on proposed reforms to immigration enforcement operations.The standoff stems from a political dispute over conditions Democrats want attached to homeland security appropriations — particularly changes to how federal immigration agents operate. item.title: Two Dead, Three Injured in Shooting at Rhode Island Hockey Game
item.description: A shooting at a hockey arena in Pawtucket has left two people dead and three others injured.Police say the violence broke out during a game being played at the arena Saturday afternoon. Investigators believe the shooting stemmed from a family dispute. Among those killed was reportedly a young girl.Authorities confirmed the suspected gunman is also dead from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. item.title: Act for MS Hosts 4th Annual Golf Tournament in Palm Desert
item.description: Golfers and supporters gathered in Palm Desert today for the fourth annual Act for MS fundraising tournament.The event teed off at noon at Palm Valley Country Club and featured a silent auction, dinner, and live entertainment for guests and players.ACT for MS was founded to improve the quality of life for people living with multiple sclerosis. The organization offers strength training and cardiovascular programs, educational seminars, mental health support, and assistance with mobility equipment

item.title: Local Fire Stations Providing Sandbags for Residents’ Safety
item.description: Local authorities are helping residents prepare for potential flooding by providing sandbags at fire stations across the Coachella Valley. Currently, stations in Palm Springs, Cathedral City, and Desert Hot Springs are distributing sandbags for residents to use around homes and businesses.Fire officials say sandbags can help reduce water damage during heavy rains or localized flooding, especially in low-lying areas. item.title: High-Speed Crash on I-10 Near Hog and Lehman Way Blocks Train Traffic, Causes Minor Injuries
item.description: California Highway Patrol responded to a traffic collision on the eastbound I-10 Freeway near Hog and Lehman Way in Riverside County, causing significant traffic delays during rush hour. According to CHP officials, the crash was caused by a vehicle traveling at high speed.The vehicle left the roadway and ended up on nearby railroad tracks, temporarily halting train traffic while crews worked to clear the obstruction. item.description: A nonprofit in Sierra Vista, Arizona, is helping disabled veterans rediscover the joy of cycling while building strong community connections.Velo Vets was founded in 2017 with a simple mission — help veterans stay active, get outdoors, and connect with one another through group rides.
